title: HPL signed event wrapper v1
description:
One line of an .hplevent file (JSON Lines). sig = lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "hpl.signed_event.v1
" + pairing_id + "
" + ts + "
" + body), where body is the exact UTF-8 string of an hpl.event.v1 JSON object (no re-serialization, so no canonicalization is needed) and secret is the 32-byte pairing secret. ts is Unix seconds when the producer signed. See docs/m5-glasses.md.
